question: A lift serves floors 1 to 20. How many different journeys are there from a lower floor to a higher one?
move: Every "how many pairs" question is the same question wearing a costume.
hint: Every journey is just a pair of floors, and the lower one comes first.
steps: Choose any two of the 20 floors: 20 x 19 = 380 ordered pairs.
Each unordered pair gives exactly one upward journey, so halve it.
